findings.finding: B149 describes Filter Drive input gain, but its manual selection is OP010/OP016 and its note discusses envelope timing, filter-frequency modulation and Play by Key. B150 describes the continuous Morph-filter position, but selects OP017 and repeats its shaper/Drive/wet100-to0 bypass note, without G25. These are distinct controls: OP010 envelope stages and OP016 filter-frequency tracking do not assess Filter Drive; OP017 shaper choice/drive/wet bypass does not assess Morph. The rows therefore misroute the exact source context even though their quoted bytes and generic pointer integrity are correct.
findings.counterexample: A reviewer following B150 to its selected OP017 requirement/case reaches a shaper wet-bypass history and cannot find the Morph control or its existing snap-versus-continuous distinction. Following B149 reaches envelope/PlayByKey histories instead of eligible filter Drive. No application behavior is observed or contradicted; the defect is in the source-to-record association.
findings.preserved_true: B058/B059 already correctly associate OP015 with missing continuous Morph movement versus actual named Morph snaps. OP017 is a true shaper/Drive productive wet100-to0 experiment for B151–B153 and must remain there. G25 already proposes eligible Drive/continuousMorph changes; no new proposal group, normative ID or case is needed.
